verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission successfully completed a 10-day crewed lunar flyby in April 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "the launch is scheduled for April 1... the mission will last about 10 days"; "Artemis 2 is scheduled for launch in late 2024"; "Leading the nearly 10-day mission"; "Artemis II will be NASA’s first crewed flight test... around the Moon"
verifications.reasoning: Sources uniformly describe the mission as planned/upcoming using future tense ('will', 'scheduled', 'leading'), not completed. 'Successfully completed' is unsupported. Dates conflict (late 2024 in R2 vs. April 1/2026 context in others).

verifications.claim: Reid Wiseman was a NASA astronaut and the commander of the Artemis II mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The mission will be commanded by US astronaut Reid Wiseman"; "Reid Wiseman, 47 (NASA)"; "Commander Reid Wiseman"; "Commander Reid Wiseman"; "Commander Reid Wiseman"
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly identify Reid Wiseman as a NASA astronaut and commander of Artemis II.

verifications.claim: Victor Glover was a NASA astronaut and the pilot of the Artemis II mission.

verifications.evidence: "Victor Glover"; "Victor Glover, 46 (NASA)"; "Pilot Victor Glover"; "Pilot Victor Glover"; "pilot Victor Glover"
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm Victor Glover as NASA astronaut on Artemis II; R3, R4, R5 explicitly state pilot role.
